seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Speak to Gelian about partnerships, trade opportunities, market entry into Sri Lanka, supplier introductions or co-investment. We reply to every serious enquiry within three working days.

header.title: Start a conversation.
header.lede: We are a small team and we read everything ourselves. Short and concrete beats long and polished — tell us what it is, who it is for, and what you need that is not capital.

form.title: Send a message.
form.body: We reply to every serious enquiry within three working days. If we are not the right people, we will say so quickly rather than leave you waiting.

details.locationNote: Full registered address available on request. We meet by appointment rather than drop-in.

collaboration.title: Where a conversation is most likely to go somewhere.
collaboration.lede: We are not trying to be reachable by everyone. These are the kinds of enquiry we are genuinely set up to act on.

items.title: Operators & founders
items.body: You are already doing the difficult part, and the constraint is distribution, brand or capital rather than capability. This is the conversation we most want to have.

items.title: Makers & suppliers
items.body: Growers, cutters, weavers, workshops and small manufacturers across our areas of exploration. We build relationships years before we need them.

items.title: Trade & distribution partners
items.body: Operators who move goods reliably across a border, in either direction, and who share our interest in doing it properly rather than quickly.

items.title: Inbound market entry
items.body: International operators looking at Sri Lanka who need a partner accountable for the outcome, rather than a consultant accountable for a deck.

items.title: Co-investors & family offices
items.body: Principals with a complementary corridor or category. We share opportunities rarely and carefully, but we do share them.

items.title: Press & speaking
items.body: We speak on Sri Lankan categories, cross-border trade and long-horizon holding structures — and decline more of these than we accept.

collaboration.declineNote: What we cannot help with: requests for donations or sponsorship, unsolicited agency and outsourcing pitches, and cold approaches asking us to invest in businesses outside our areas of exploration. No offence intended in saying so — it saves everyone a week.
